g.text: Outside APIs: Bright Data and Claude
The Evidence Engine (Elastic Serverless): organize and check
Event data pipeline: Bright Data, then the Evidence Engine, then SpacetimeDB
Runs once before the event from any event's public pages (Cal Hacks 13.0 is the first run), so no live step waits on a scrape. Bright Data does every fetch, Rust does
the deterministic stages, the Evidence Engine organizes, and SpacetimeDB loads the checked bundle in one transaction.
Kibana: the Workflows run view shows every step and every merge with the agent's reason;
